## Behavior and acceptance criteria

Describe the smallest independently verifiable behavior changed by this PR.

## Risk boundary

- [ ] No signing, nonce, state or recovery boundary changed
- [ ] Boundary changed and fail-closed tests are included
- [ ] Deployment is out of scope or separately evidenced
- [ ] Live activation is out of scope or explicitly authorized

## Verification

Include the exact commands and results. Do not describe configured or simulated behavior as live runtime proof.
